notes.title: The real Tracercoin wallet is here
items: A real Windows installer for Tracercoin Core is published as a release candidate.
Every release lists a SHA-256 checksum — verify the download before you run it.
This replaces the interim Litecoin-based brand-test build with genuine Tracercoin binaries.
Prerequisites ship with the release so you have everything needed at install time.
The build is not yet code-signed; Windows may warn on first run until signing lands.

notes.title: A transparent treasury fee, enforced by the network
items: Two percent of every block now routes to the disclosed development treasury.
The first block pays the full, publicly disclosed development allocation to the treasury.
Nodes reject any block that does not pay the treasury correctly — the rule is consensus-enforced.
This keeps the fair-launch development allocation transparent from block one.

notes.title: The site now leads with getting started
items: The Get Started guide is now the tracercoin.org home page.
The project overview — what it is, fingerprints, and specs — moved to /about/.
The waitlist signup lives on the home page, and this status board is one click away.

notes.title: See your place in line
items: The waitlist now returns your live position number when you join or verify.
Pages show a "You're on the list #N" badge once you've signed up.
Your position is cached locally so it reappears on every visit.

notes.title: The site knows you're in
items: Join-waitlist calls to action now hide automatically once you're registered.
Live pool connection details are gated behind miner-portal login.
No flash of the wrong UI — your state is applied before the page paints.

notes.title: Miner portal login is live
items: Create a miner account and sign in to the portal.
Signed-in miners can view the live stratum URL, port, and worker settings.

notes.title: Tracercoin.org goes live over HTTPS
items: Public site deployed to production with a valid HTTPS certificate.
Home and waitlist, mining start guide, and pool pages published.
Phone-verified waitlist signup open to the public.
